cover.note: House 3's gate on a grey winter morning: a messenger hands an order slip to a clerk under the portico; behind, a loader lifts a grain sack beside the board of numbered slots.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: the stone quay of a Hellenistic Greek port town, dark sea water below the quay edge and beyond. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real stone, tile, rock and scrub. The building on the quay becomes a long colonnaded stone portico with a terracotta roof. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its messenger and pouch exactly. Under the portico the messenger hands a small folded papyrus slip to a clerk in a plain grey-blue tunic holding a wax tablet. Behind them on the portico wall, a long timber board with a row of open wooden slots, each marked with a Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits, some holding small clay tablets, a short wooden peg standing in one slot; beside it a loader in a coarse brown tunic lifts a grain sack. No other people. Nothing modern.

b01-goatherd.note: The goatherd on a track high on the spur above House 2's harbour, pointing down to the port; the cliff road round the bay below.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a small Hellenistic Greek port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs below a steep hillside, a long stone pier in the harbour, the sea beyond. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real maquis, pine, rock, stone and roof tile. Winter late morning under low grey overcast, cloud low on the hills: soft flat light, no hard shadows. In the foreground on a narrow stony goat track among the scrub: a weathered goatherd in a rough undyed wool tunic and a sheepskin cape, holding a crook, with four or five goats around him, pointing down toward the town. Below, a narrow road cut into the hillside runs round the bay into the town. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: the stone quay of a Hellenistic Greek port town, the sea beyond. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real stone, tile, rock and scrub. The building on the quay becomes a long colonnaded stone portico with a terracotta roof. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. Under the portico, mid-frame: a long timber board fixed to the wall at chest height, a row of about twelve open wooden slots, each marked with a painted Greek numeral; the first few hold small clay order tablets, some are empty, and a short wooden peg stands in the first slot nobody has taken. Two clerks, one in a grey-blue tunic and one in an olive tunic, reach for neighbouring slots at the same moment, one moving the peg along; a loader in a coarse brown tunic walks along the row from the first slot, a grain sack by him. No other people. Nothing modern.
